officialProviderReferences.use: Namecheap documents MX as a supported DNS host record type.
Namecheap documents the Mail Settings modes, including Email Forwarding and Custom MX.

decision.reason: The required subdomain MX record for send.contact.archestimator.com was not available in the visible Host Records picker, and switching Mail Settings from Email Forwarding to Custom MX would risk interrupting SUPPORT_INBOX_PLACEHOLDER forwarding.
decision.safeNextStep: Ask Namecheap support whether a subdomain MX can be added while keeping domain Email Forwarding, use a DNS provider that supports independent subdomain MX records without breaking apex forwarding, or move support mail to the same custom MX provider deliberately.
